desc: Do note that [this](https://en.touhouwiki.net/wiki/Embodiment_of_Scarlet_Devil/Story/Reimu's_Scenario#:%7E:text=%EF%BC%92%E6%99%82%E9%96%93%E5%89%8D%E3%81%AB%E5%87%BA%E7%9B%B4%E3%81%97%E3%81%A6%E3%81%8D%E3%81%AA) play on the common Japanese phrase – "come back the day before yesterday" – essentially translates to Sakuya telling you sod off.
